latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of aminer-data-search skill.
- Supports academic data queries and analysis via 28 AMiner Open Platform APIs.
- Provides 6 major workflow combinations: scholar profile, paper deep dive, institution analysis, journal monitoring, academic QA, and patent analysis.
- Includes detailed usage instructions, API selection guide, and error handling/retry strategies.
- Python client script for easy API/workflow calls.
